name: tinto-travels-plugins
description: Self-service plugin catalog for the Tinto Travels team's Cowork accounts — guest communication, supplier logistics, booking-page publishing, winery-record entry, and client itinerary PDF plugins, each installable independently by whoever needs it.

plugins.name: tinto-guest-communication
plugins.description: Nélia's guide to daily guest and winery-client email communications.

plugins.name: tinto-logistics
plugins.description: Tamara's guide to supplier communications, rooming lists, and transport-company itineraries.

plugins.name: tinto-booking-pages
plugins.description: Auditing a tour's booking-page readiness and publishing it live — a standalone plugin for whoever handles publishing, separate from Nélia's guest communication plugin.

plugins.name: tinto-add-winery-record
plugins.description: Entering an already-agreed winery client's record and branding into Airtable — a standalone plugin, installable on its own by anyone who needs it (e.g. Peter).

plugins.name: tinto-client-itinerary-pdf
plugins.description: Building the dated, tour-specific client itinerary PDF used to sell a tour — a standalone plugin, installable on its own by anyone who needs it (e.g. Peter).
